text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Takarazuka Kinen fan voting 
results, Zenno Rob Roy took first place. 
Sweep Tosho wasn't even in the top 20.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a middle-distance race, and a Senior 
class one at that, there's no way a girl 
from the Triple Tiara route could ever 
beat contenders from the Triple Crown 
route—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that everyone feels the same 
way, Sweep Tosho is inspired to try even 
harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having defeated Zenno Rob Roy, who became 
a hero as promised, now is the time to 
change the world with magic.
